academicReview.programmeComparability: The corrected closest programme responds substantially to normal/atypical development, cognition/language, child-inclusive assessment and research, with bounded educational application in primary-school rhetoric and youth learning environments. The case is not justified by general psychology coherence or a disclaimer alone. Its actual developmental and cognitive content, assessment and evidence training answer central university-level ALPO questions. Dedicated pedagogy, curriculum/didactics, professional practice and the legal teacher pathway remain material gaps. The withdrawn biomedical option cannot establish comparable orthopedagogical study merely through cellular and disease content.

stopping.assessment: Stop at one. The strongest developmental-support content is now included in the closest programme: lifespan and abnormal psychology, clinical assessment and therapy perspectives, language, youth resilience and empirical methods. The old second programme achieved difference mainly through evolution, cellular biology, molecular pathology, laboratory work, infection, immunity and organ disease. Those subjects do not implement a distinct orthopedagogical or learning-support curriculum. No credible separate 24-course developmental-support programme can be formed by padding this limited content; simple removal or reshuffling would not establish qualitative distinctness. Educational quality and curriculum design remains a genuine but infeasible further direction because dedicated educational evaluation, curriculum and didactics courses are absent.
